about:
Ten ratings from Table 31.9 of the Spanish edition, floor-ceiling systems, under three full-width group headings: concrete joists, steel sections, and timber joists or frames. The page prints a floor ("Suelo") and a ceiling ("Techo") for each numbered row; the floor is the name here and the ceiling the variant, because three floors are printed once and rated under two or three ceilings. The printed row number is the key, and the four floors printed as "Igual que 4", "Igual que 6" and "Igual que 8" name the row they refer to in refers_to_row.

The italic note under the caption says the ratings rest on laboratory test data with a high degree of reliability, that particular tests may differ slightly because of measurement technique and minor construction details, that the absorbent materials of the table are mineral and glass fibre or cellulose, and that the fill must exceed two thirds of the cavity volume ("Los materiales absorbentes incluidos en la tabla son fibra mineral y de vidrio, o celulosa, y el relleno debe superar los dos tercios del volumen de la cámara de aire").
